summary: Single-commit branch from 2026-05-03 that wraps require('dotenv').config() in a try/catch in integrations/test-e2e-flow.js. The fix prevents test bootstrap failures when devDependencies are absent in CI/quality-gate environments. Change is not present on main.

evidence.commitSubject: fix: make e2e test bootstrap resilient without dotenv
evidence.changeDescription: Wraps require('dotenv').config() in try/catch with comment explaining why: allows tests to run when devDependencies are omitted in CI/quality-gate environments. Also adds a 14-line task-spec comment block at top of file.
evidence.existingPRs: No PR found for this branch. Closest related: PR #1923 (CLOSED, not merged) 'Fix: Quality gate tests failing in leadflow' on dev/97173791 — different branch, different fix.
evidence.mainDotenvLine: Line 8 on main still has hard require('dotenv').config() without try/catch — confirming the fix was never merged.

riskDetail: Change is isolated to a test file (integrations/test-e2e-flow.js), is purely defensive (try/catch around optional devDependency load), has no effect on production paths, and adds no new dependencies. The task-spec comment block at the top of the file is non-functional.
recommendation: Create a PR from dev/655c215d-fix-quality-gate-tests-failing-in-genome into main. The fix addresses a real quality-gate failure pattern (dotenv MODULE_NOT_FOUND in CI) and the change is safe and minimal. Assign a task ID before merging to close the orphan gap.
commandsRun: gh pr list --search 'make e2e test bootstrap resilient' --state all
